mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 68 degrees at Harriet Park under a full moon, with an overnight low of 50 degrees and no rain expected. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.
The City of Verona is accepting feedback on several proposed developments, including the Ardent Glen project, ahead of the November 4th Plan Commission meeting.
We have a busy weekend ahead, starting with live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company today, followed by yoga tomorrow and the Main Street Trick or Treat this Wednesday.
On Thursday, October 15, the Verona Police Department conducted an investigation that led to the arrest of a school bus driver for O W I.
Stop by Culver's today for the Snickers Swirl flavor of the day; they are open until 10:00 PM tonight.
